Sir Patrick Stewart, whose distinctive voice helped him embody everything from USS Enterprise Captain Jean-Luc Picard to the X-Men’s Professor X to Ebenezer Scrooge to an emoji, has died .
His decades-long career spans the stage, the big screen, TV and commercials. He worked across genres from sci-fi to Shakespeare, to historical dramas to superhero films to comedy and animation.
RELATED: 2026 Deaths Photo Gallery: Hollywood & Media Obituaries
Scroll through the gallery below to see highlights from his wide and varied filmography.
